d: Müller's Solutions supports organizations in strengthening technology governance, managing risk, and meeting regulatory expectations. Based in Riyadh, the company works with stakeholders in the Saudi financial sector on initiatives that improve the resilience, accountability, and performance of IT environments. Its work brings together governance, risk, compliance, and IT process improvement, helping organizations translate regulatory requirements into practical frameworks, clear controls, and sustainable ways of working.

Müller's Solutions is seeking an experienced GRC Specialist to contribute to a SAMA-aligned IT Risk and IT Compliance Assessment programme. In this role, you will assess governance arrangements, identify technology and compliance risks, and help develop or improve policies, processes, and control practices. You will work closely with IT teams and business stakeholders to understand how existing processes operate, evaluate them against relevant requirements, and recommend improvements that can be implemented and monitored.

The position calls for a professional who can connect regulatory expectations with day-to-day technology operations. You will contribute to assessment activities from evidence gathering and analysis through to documentation and recommendations. Clear communication, sound judgment, and a practical approach to problem-solving will be important when discussing findings, validating information, and supporting stakeholders through improvement work. This opportunity is suited to someone who is comfortable managing multiple workstreams and producing structured, reliable outputs for a regulated environment.
q: Seven to ten years of professional experience in IT governance, risk, and compliance, preferably in financial services or another regulated industry.
Strong working knowledge of the SAMA Cybersecurity Framework and its application to technology governance, risk management, and compliance assessments.
Demonstrated experience implementing or improving governance frameworks, IT policies, standards, procedures, and related control documentation.
Practical understanding of IT risk and compliance assessment methods, including control review, evidence assessment, gap analysis, and remediation planning.
Ability to communicate requirements and findings clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and management audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills, with careful attention to accuracy and traceability.
Ability to collaborate across teams, manage priorities, and contribute effectively to concurrent governance and process improvement workstreams.
Professional fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills and relevant industry certifications are advantageous.
r: Support delivery of the SAMA-aligned IT Risk and IT Compliance Assessment programme across governance, risk, compliance, and IT process improvement activities.
Review existing IT governance arrangements, policies, standards, procedures, and controls to evaluate alignment with applicable requirements.
Gather and assess documentation, records, and stakeholder input to establish how controls and processes are designed and operating.
Identify gaps, control weaknesses, and technology-related risks, and document findings with clear supporting evidence.
Develop practical recommendations, corrective actions, and improvement plans in collaboration with relevant IT and business owners.
Help stakeholders clarify roles, responsibilities, approval paths, and ongoing monitoring practices within governance frameworks.
Prepare organized assessment materials, status updates, findings, and other programme deliverables for review.
Track agreed actions and support follow-up activities to help confirm progress and maintain consistent documentation.
Build effective working relationships with IT teams and stakeholders while communicating issues constructively and professionally.
x: This role offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful IT risk and compliance work in Saudi Arabia’s financial sector. You will collaborate with varied stakeholders, apply your GRC expertise to practical assessment challenges, and help shape governance and process improvements. The position provides exposure to a range of workstreams and the chance to develop further experience in regulatory alignment, control assessment, and technology risk management. Role arrangements and applicable employment benefits will be discussed as part of the hiring process.

Müller's Solutions is committed to fair and respectful employment practices. Applicants will be considered on the basis of relevant qualifications, experience, and role requirements, without discrimination on grounds protected by applicable law. The company values a professional environment where people can contribute with integrity and respect.
